name: banking_intents_final
instructions: What is the customer's banking intent or issue? Look for specific action words and context.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card received - 'activate my card', 'how do I activate'
criteria.age_limit: Asking about age restrictions for service
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Adding to mobile wallet or using with Apple/Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: ATM problems, cash withdrawal, finding ATM - 'ATM broken', 'can't withdraw', 'ATM near me'
criteria.automatic_top_up: Asking about automatic top-up feature or setup
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Received transfer but waiting for balance to show - 'waiting for deposit to show', 'money sent to me not here yet'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited cheque/cash, balance delayed - 'deposited cheque not showing', 'cash deposited but balance not updated'
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling a transfer already sent - 'cancel my transfer', 'undo transfer I sent'
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring, needs renewal - 'card expires soon', 'need new card before expiry'
criteria.card_acceptance: Where card can be used - 'merchants accept this card', 'virtual card for memberships'
criteria.card_arrival: When will ordered card arrive - 'when will my card come', 'has card been sent'
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Estimated delivery date or express shipping - 'express delivery available', 'when do you deliver'
criteria.card_linking: Linking card to app or account
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working at payment/ATM - 'card rejected at store', 'ATM won't accept card'
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fee charged for making a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Made payment but not showing in account - 'my payment missing', 'where's my payment'
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to card payment
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for ATM withdrawal - 'ATM charged fee', 'why was I charged for withdrawal'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Withdrew cash but withdrawal not in account
criteria.compromised_card: Card fraudulently used - 'someone using my card', 'unauthorized payment on card', 'fraud on my account'
criteria.country_support: Service in specific country - 'can I use in X country', 'do you operate in Europe', 'support in my country'
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment rejected at checkout - 'card was declined', 'payment rejected at store'
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Direct debit made but not showing - 'direct debit missing from account'
criteria.exchange_rate: Asking how exchange rates work or pricing
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Unexpected charge, fraud concern - 'unknown charge on account', 'charge I didn't authorize', 'unfamiliar charge'
criteria.failed_transfer: Transfer didn't go through - 'transfer failed', 'transfer not possible', 'transfer error'
criteria.getting_spare_card: Requesting extra/spare physical card for other person - 'card for family member', 'second card for account'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen - 'lost my card', 'card stolen'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost/stolen, security concern - 'can't access account without phone'
criteria.order_physical_card: Placing new physical card order - 'how do I order card', 'is new card free'
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment waiting to post - 'when will payment post'
criteria.pending_transfer: Waiting on specific transfer status - 'my transfer still pending', 'how long for this transfer'
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving income/transfers in general - 'can I receive salary', 'receive money in account'
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Expecting refund but hasn't appeared - 'refund missing', 'where's my refund'
criteria.request_refund: Requesting refund for a transaction - 'I want a refund', 'refund this purchase'
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Card payment was reversed - 'my payment reverted', 'payment undone', 'payment reversed'
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: What cards/currencies are supported - 'what payment methods', 'which currencies do you accept'
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Top-up via cash or cheque deposit
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up attempt failed - 'top-up didn't work', 'top-up rejected'
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up was reversed/undone - 'top-up canceled', 'top-up reversed', 'top-up money gone'
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Adding funds using card - 'add funds using card', 'how to top up'
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Same transaction charged twice - 'charged twice for one purchase'
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Fee charged for sending transfer - 'why charged for transfer', 'transfer fee'
criteria.transfer_into_account: Initiating transfer to own account - 'send money to my account', 'receive a transfer'
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient hasn't received sent transfer - 'where is recipient's money', 'sent transfer but recipient hasn't got it'
criteria.transfer_timing: How long do transfers take in general - 'how long for international transfer', 'transfer time frame'
criteria.verify_top_up: Need verification code for top-up - 'verification code for top-up', 'verify top-up'
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asking if card is Visa or Mastercard
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on cash withdrawal
